title: Possible Outcome Pack
description: Structural reference for a declarative contract describing one observable, verifiable outcome. Runtime validation additionally enforces semantic relationships and lifecycle rules.
$comment: Catalog numbers are public presentation metadata and intentionally do not belong in this manifest schema.

schemaVersion.description: The manifest contract in use. Currently 1.

packVersion.description: The semantic revision of this pack.

visibility.description: Where the manifest may be distributed. This is not permission.

lifecycle.description: The maturity of the contract. Reviewed status never grants authority.

lane.description: The broad kind of work, not a hidden workflow schema.

name.description: The human-readable outcome, not a tool or implementation name.

eyebrow.description: A short catalog label for scanning.

promise.description: One concise statement of the observable result this pack should make true.

summary.description: The fuller plain-language outcome, including its shape and stopping boundary. This is the description; do not add a separate description field.

reviewedAt.description: The date the author or owning repository last reviewed the contract as complete enough to compile. This is not Possible catalog trust.

useWhen.description: Concrete starting conditions that make this pack a fit.

notFor.description: Explicit non-scope and nearest cases to reject or redirect.

skills.description: Reviewed, pinned capabilities needed to do the work.

workstreams.description: Independently owned slices with skills, artifacts, briefs, and dependencies.

reviewSkills.description: Capabilities used to challenge and verify the integrated result.

outputs.description: Artifacts the run leaves behind. Outputs are not proof by themselves.

guardrails.description: Non-negotiable safety, authority, provenance, content, and external-action boundaries.

verification.description: Fresh checks or reviews that can falsify the expectations on the integrated result.

expectations.description: The observable definition-of-done checklist. Each item needs failure modes and required evidence.

archived.description: The reason and replacements for an archived pack.

id.description: Stable local identifier used by workstreams.

role.description: The capability's bounded contribution to this outcome.

installSource.description: The exact source passed to the Skills installer, when it differs from the repository.

installMode.description: Whether to install the named skill only or its full reviewed depth.

skill.description: The skill name installed from the source.

catalogUrl.description: A human-facing catalog or discovery link.

reviewedRevision.description: The exact reviewed source revision to pin.

reviewUrl.description: The source URL for the reviewed revision.

id.description: Stable local identifier for this ownership slice.

skills.description: Skill IDs this workstream may use.

owns.description: Artifacts or decisions this workstream owns.

brief.description: Plain-language work boundary, context, and completion handoff.

dependsOn.description: Workstream IDs that must complete first.

activation.description: Evidence-based condition for when this workstream applies.

id.description: Stable identifier referenced by evidence and receipts.

statement.description: An observable statement of what must become true.

level.description: Whether failure blocks completion or records a quality gap.

failureModes.description: Concrete ways this expectation could fail.

requiredEvidence.description: Direct artifacts, checks, or observations needed to assess it.

archivedAt.description: The date the pack was archived.

reason.description: Why this contract is retained but no longer recommended.

replacementSlugs.description: Stable slugs for focused replacements, if any.
